title: Toxic
headline: Kylie Minogue heard a snippet of 'Toxic' and passed. Britney Spears didn't.
caption:
'Toxic' (2004) was the second single from Britney Spears' fourth album, In the Zone, and became one of her signature songs.

The video had its own drama. It was her most expensive video to that point, at $1 million. Then, after the Super Bowl halftime controversy, MTV moved it to late-night programming, saying it was "erring on the side of caution."

In 2010, Britney revealed on Twitter that 'Toxic' is her favorite song in her catalog.

Could you picture Kylie singing 'Toxic', or was it always Britney's song?
